what: NETTED-SLICES soak (bybit_1): when one slice's TP fires on a multi-slice book, does Bybit cancel THAT slice's paired Partial SL leg? The netting reconciler's leg-gone attribution (_netting_rows_to_attribute) keys on sl_order_id only, and Bybit's /position/trading-stop docs do not say whether partial TP and SL are one-cancels-other. If the SL leg survives, it is an orphan reduce-only leg sized to a closed slice that can later close ANOTHER slice's qty -- cross-slice contamination of the ledger. Also confirm the Σ leg sizes == venue net after each slice exit.
